how: We read the website of every Los Angeles wedding photographer listed on Lazo (225 listings, 182 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a national photo-and-DJ chain with an Orange County landing page, a photographer based in Irvine, a Seattle-and-LA studio selling mini sessions, and family-portrait studios. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: How do you handle harsh midday sun and the marine layer? Ask to see a full gallery from a bright beach wedding and a foggy one.
Will you be the person shooting my wedding, and is a second photographer included or an add-on?
What is the turnaround for sneak peeks and the full gallery, and do you deliver film scans as well as digital?

picks.name: itla photo
picks.blurb: A queer-owned photography duo in Los Angeles that has documented more than 600 stories since 2014; the two photographed weddings separately before joining forces in 2019. itla photo says most couples fall between $7k and $12k, takes a limited number of weddings and books dates 4 to 12 months out.

picks.name: Lovesaver Weddings
picks.blurb: Serge and Nadin are a husband-and-wife team originally from Ukraine and now based in Los Angeles. Nadin brings over 15 years in film directing, photography and editing, Serge more than ten in photography and cinematography, and LoveSaver Weddings offers both stills and films from the same pair.

picks.name: NZ WEDDING STUDIO Los Angeles Wedding Photographer
picks.blurb: Nem has photographed weddings since 2011, starting his career in Europe before settling in Los Angeles. NZ Wedding Studio mixes fine art portraits with candid moments, offers videography too, and publishes a page on what a Los Angeles wedding photographer costs rather than leaving you to guess.

picks.name: Bright Day Photography
picks.blurb: Dmitrii Raposo-Oleinik photographs every wedding himself, with over 12 years behind the camera and a bright, editorial style. Bright Day packages list one photographer, timeline planning, 48-hour sneak peeks and a high-resolution edited gallery, for couples across Southern California and beyond.

picks.name: Daria Noir Photography
picks.blurb: Daria spent ten years in TV production in Japan as a journalist and producer before turning to photography, and planning her own wedding in 2021 pulled her into the wedding world. Her Los Angeles wedding and elopement work aims for the honest, cinematic feel of a quiet moment in an indie film.

picks.name: Breana Isley Photography
picks.blurb: Breana Isley blends documentary storytelling with an editorial eye for luxury weddings across Los Angeles, Orange County, Malibu, Santa Monica and Beverly Hills, plus destinations worldwide. She describes herself as the calm in the beautiful chaos.

picks.name: Lovelace Photo Co.
picks.blurb: Lovelace is his real last name. On weekdays he works in the Cinema and TV Department at Los Angeles City College, and weekends belong to weddings, with a calendar he keeps intentionally small so each couple gets his full attention. Warm, candid photography in Encino and across Southern California.

picks.name: The Shalom Imaginative
picks.blurb: Nate and Amanda started The Shalom Imaginative over a decade ago, and it has grown into a collective shooting candid, documentary-style photo and video on analog film and digital. Starting prices are printed on the site, from $3,600, with full pricing on inquiry. Everyone is welcome.

picks.name: Alex Lee Photography
picks.blurb: Alex studied music and expected a life on stage before picking up a camera. He started the business in Washington DC in 2018, moved to Los Angeles in 2021 and splits time between both coasts; when you book him, he is the one shooting and editing, with no associate photographers.

picks.name: Elli Lauren Photography
picks.blurb: A documentary wedding photographer who has worked full time since 2013 and came up through music photography, with commercial clients including Adidas and Toms. Elli Lauren shoots Los Angeles, Ojai, Santa Barbara, Joshua Tree and Palm Springs and says her favorite light is the first and last hour of the day.

picks.name: The I Do Wedding Photography & Videography
picks.blurb: The I Do began when two film-industry transplants photographed their first wedding and were hooked; more than 500 weddings later it is a studio of photographers and filmmakers. Indian, Persian and intercultural weddings are its specialty, with teams in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York and Arizona.

picks.name: Lulan Studio
picks.blurb: Lulan Wang founded Lulan Studio in Los Angeles in 2016 on the idea that a photograph should hold what a day felt like. The studio shoots digital and 35mm film, offers video from the same team, and its collections page lists two studio photographers and eight hours of coverage with monthly payment plans.
